# BAD-091 — preview_start's port-reuse can silently serve the wrong worktree

## Brief
Root cause of BAD-055: mcp__Claude_Browser__preview_start's own description says it 'Reuses the server if already running.' That reuse is scoped to the port (8901, hardcoded in scripts/web-server.js and pinned in .claude/launch.json's web entry, no per-worktree override), not to the caller's checkout. A worktree session gets no error and no signal that it attached to another checkout's process -- it just silently serves that tree. Documentation (this ticket) tells agents to check what they got, but a tooling fix would prevent the footgun rather than rely on every agent remembering to verify.

Evidence: BAD-044 (2026-09-15): preview_start name=web from a worktree served main's app.js (1909 lines, 1 <script> tag) instead of the worktree's own (176 lines, 12 tags); npm run web from inside the worktree served the worktree correctly. scripts/web-server.js:24 ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..'); .claude/launch.json's web entry sets no PORT/cwd override; preview_start tool description: 'Reuses the server if already running.' Two possible fixes: have .claude/launch.json's web entry pick a free/worktree-scoped port, or have preview_start verify the served content's origin/cwd matches before reusing a process.
